pinterest.title: Celebrity Engagement Rings: 25 Rings and the Style Family Behind Each One
pinterest.description: Celebrity engagement rings, read the way a jeweller would. From a serpent ring given in 1839 to an old mine cut diamond announced in 2025, each of the 25 rings is broken down by cut, setting and style family, with a Get the look line on who it suits. The list narrows to eight looks you can ask a jeweller for by name, from the emerald-cut solitaire to the toi et moi, plus tips for wearing a statement ring at a destination wedding.

pinterest.title: Royal Engagement Rings: Heirloom Diamonds, Birthstones and National Colours
pinterest.description: Royal engagement rings lean on meaning more than size. Queen Victoria's serpent ring set an emerald reported as her birthstone. Queen Elizabeth II's ring used diamonds from a tiara that belonged to Prince Philip's mother. Queen Mary of Denmark's rubies were reported as chosen to echo the Danish flag. Have family stones? They can be reset into a new design rather than worn in an old mount. See all 25 famous engagement rings and the style behind each.

pinterest.title: Taylor Swift Engagement Ring: The Old Mine Cut and Bezel Look, Explained
pinterest.description: Taylor Swift announced her engagement on Instagram on 26 August 2025. Her publicist said the diamond is an old mine brilliant cut, an antique style with a softer, chunkier sparkle than a modern round brilliant. It sits in a yellow gold bezel, a rim of metal that wraps the edge of the stone. Get the look: a vintage-inspired ring with an antique-cut diamond in yellow gold. A bezel protects the stone's edge better than raised claws, so it suits an active life.
pinterest.visual: Text-led style card (old mine cut, yellow gold bezel) with no likeness. Never the couple's own announcement photos; use the ring_23 photo only if its licence explicitly covers promotional social use.

slides: 25 celebrity engagement rings, read the way a jeweller would: cut, setting and the style family each one belongs to.
Royal rings lean on meaning more than size: heirloom diamonds, birthstones and national colours.
Grace Kelly, Beyonce, Amal Clooney, Sofia Richie Grainge. The emerald cut keeps coming back. Get the look: an emerald-cut solitaire, or add tapered baguettes for more width.
Diana's sapphire, later Catherine's. Get the look: a halo around a coloured stone, which frames the centre stone from every angle.
Side stones are easy to miss. Priyanka Chopra Jonas's and Miranda Kerr's rings are often listed as solitaires, yet sources describe tapered baguettes on either side.
Recent rings favour character: Taylor Swift's old mine cut in a yellow gold bezel, Zendaya's cushion set east-west, Selena Gomez's marquise.
Wearing it at a wedding abroad? Have the fit checked before a long-haul flight, choose a low or bezel setting, and take pearls off before the beach.
Found your style family? Tell us which one below, and chat with a Wedded Advisor about where the ring makes its first trip.
instagram_carousel.caption:
Most lists of celebrity engagement rings stop at the photograph. Ours reads each ring the way a jeweller would: the cut, the setting and the style family, then who that look suits.

25 rings, from a serpent ring given in 1839 to an old mine cut diamond announced in 2025, narrowed to eight looks you can ask for by name.

A few things the list teaches:
Royal rings lean on meaning more than size, using heirloom diamonds, birthstones and national colours.
Three-stone and side-stone settings are more common than they first appear, because tapered baguettes are easy to miss in photographs.
Name the style family, not the celebrity. Ask for "an emerald-cut solitaire" or "a three-stone with tapered baguettes", then adjust the size, metal and details to your hand and your life.

Travelling for the wedding? A low or bezel setting copes better with active days than tall claws, and pearls should come off before the beach.

The full guide is linked in bio.

Which style family is yours? Tell us below, or chat with a Wedded Advisor once the conversation turns to where.
